response.reason: The implementation is a standard radix-2 decimation-in-frequency complex FFT of the packed half-length sequence followed by the correct real-FFT reconstruction (verified algebraically: xr/xi formulas, Nyquist bin = Re Z[0]-Im Z[0], k=0 bin, and twiddle folding all match the exact DFT). All arithmetic is done in FP64 with FP16 inputs, so roundoff (~1e-9 absolute even at extreme magnitudes, and ~6e-8 relative after FP32 output cast) is far inside the 1e-4 + 1e-6*|exact| tolerance, and results are finite.
